summary.headline: Synergy Green guides FY27 revenue to about ₹500 crore (+33%) with PBDIT margin up over 300 bps, while FY26 PBDIT margin fell to 13.10%.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 total income was ₹123.45 crore with PBDIT of ₹14.83 crore (12.01% margin); FY26 total income was ₹376 crore (+3.5% YoY) with PBDIT of ₹48.67 crore (13.10%). Management attributed the weak year to brownfield expansion delays, outsourcing and relocation costs, and early West Asia-linked commodity and energy inflation. Capacity was expanded from 30,000 to 45,000 TPA foundry and a 20,000 TPA machining plant was added, but ramp-up is slow with utilisation expected to reach 80-90% only over 4-5 months. Management guided to ₹500-530 crore revenue and debt of ₹175-180 crore at FY27 end.

financial_highlights.change: PBDIT down ~8% in absolute terms YoY

financial_highlights.metric: Q4 FY26 sales volume (per analyst's question, management confirmed sales ~8,500 MT)

segments.name: Wind domestic / OEM exports / direct exports / gearbox / non-wind
segments.commentary: Management described five revenue streams but gave no segment-wise revenue split. Export realisations were lower in FY26 due to discounted pricing linked to in-house machining under development; exports are ~25-30% of revenue and are on FOB basis.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue guided at ~₹500 crore (~33% growth); management said the order book points to ₹530-550 crore, with 500-530 as the realistic range.
FY27 PBDIT margin expansion of over 300 bps YoY (implies ~16-16.5% per analyst's read); each ~₹30 crore of extra revenue above ₹500 crore could add ~100 bps as overheads are covered.
Export revenue expected stable at ~25-30% of revenue; revenue split ~45% H1 and ~55% H2 in FY27.
FY28 utilisation of 90%+ is possible; management views 15-20% CAGR as the medium-term target and sees ~10-15% headroom growth in FY28 from existing capacity.

Debt expected at ₹175-180 crore at end FY27 (from ~₹165 crore), with debt-to-equity below 1.5 at peak; management expects a balance-sheet improvement later, with debt possibly falling to ₹70-100 crore.
capex_capacity: Foundry expanded from 30,000 to 45,000 TPA (brownfield); max casting weight raised from 23 to 30 MT, enabling up to 5 MW turbines.

New 20,000 TPA machining and coating plant near foundry; 5th and 6th machines to be commissioned in 2-3 weeks; 3-4 machines stabilised at ~50% utilisation; machining product development 30-40% complete.

FY26 capex of ~₹250 crore (foundry expansion and machining), funded through internal accruals, equity and debt in a ~1:1 to 1:1.2 debt-equity mix. Cost of a greenfield project was earlier estimated at ₹500-600 crore, now to be reassessed in Q2-Q3 FY27.

Land acquisition of ~15-16 acres near existing site targeted within 6-9 months; cost ~₹25 crore, funded from internal accruals. Big capex expected from FY28; commissioning of a new unit ~15 months from initiation.
10 MW solar captive capacity onboarded from October 2025; management noted some lapsed units due to a banking-policy dispute with the state electricity board.
demand_pricing: Utilisation: FY26 utilisation on the 30,000 MT base was 93%; the current month is running near 2,500 MT (about 230,000 MT annualised per management wording) with management guiding 80-90% on the expanded base over 4-5 months.
Product mix: 12 new product developments in FY26; complexity has risen versus the earlier 2-4 products for two OEMs, which is slowing ramp-up.

Customers: six of the 15 leading global OEMs; includes Vestas, Siemens Gamesa, Senvion, Adani, Envision, GE, Nordex, Flender, ZF; non-wind adds Terex, Millikron, Willow, Mahindra, L&T; L&T order for a super thermal power component and BHEL in discussion (30-40 MT casings currently imported).

Pricing: quarterly indexation for pig iron, billet and CRC; other elements reset annually. Management cited a ~₹140/kg-type realisation relation (₹135-140 per the call); a Vestas contract for Jan-Dec 2027 is near finalisation with ~30-40% growth.

Competition: only one Chinese OEM (Envision) is active; management says new entrants need 3-5 years. Yuan appreciation (~20%) and INR depreciation (~10% vs USD) are seen as positives for competitiveness. Management is considering consolidating non-wind order intake to protect focus.
Inputs: pig iron (special grade) and resin imported, ~10-12% of raw material purchases. Commodity prices reportedly rose ~20% after mid-February with a one-quarter pass-through lag.

qa_highlights.question: Why is FY27 revenue guidance ₹500 crore versus the earlier ₹530-550 crore, and what is the margin guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the order book supports ₹530-550 crore but guided ₹500-530 crore given ramp-up risk from 30-40% new headcount; ₹30 crore above ₹500 crore could add ~100 bps margin.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a margin improvement expected in Q1 FY27 from machining?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said no significant Q1 margin contribution expected; Q2 should show margin progress as 50-60% of Q1 time goes to product development.

qa_highlights.question: What is the debt position and how is land funded?
qa_highlights.answer: Debt is ~₹165 crore, expected ₹175-180 crore by FY27 end, with debt-to-equity below 1.5; land (~₹25 crore for 15-16 acres) to come from internal accruals, adding only about ₹10 crore to debt.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY28 expansion plan and timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Greenfield capex to be decided in Q3 FY27 with ~15 months commissioning; cost to be reassessed (earlier ₹500-600 crore). Equity raise is contemplated around Q4 FY27 to Q2 FY28.

qa_highlights.question: Other income is high; what drives it?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited FX gains, interest on deposits, and export incentives: duty drawback and RoDTEP at about 2% of export revenue.

qa_highlights.question: What is the sales tonnage and realisation?
qa_highlights.answer: Q4 sales ~8,500 MT (not confirmed precisely), production ~6,400 MT; realisation ~₹135-140 per kg-equivalent relation; all exports FOB.

risks_watch: Ramp-up of 45,000 MT foundry and 20,000 MT machining; utilisation target 80% by Q2 and 90%+ by FY28, with product mix complexity (12 new products) and new hires (30-40%) a constraint.

Commodity and energy inflation with a one-quarter pass-through lag; West Asia/Iran-related freight and logistics volatility; FOB exports limit freight exposure but export consignments were reported held up.
Domestic OEM scheduling volatility and seasonality (Q1 slow, Q2 rain-affected); management says 45:55 H1/H2 split.
Power-banking dispute with the state electricity board causing lapsed solar units; policy outcome to monitor.

Greenfield capex cost (₹500-600 crore, under reassessment), land acquisition, and the equity raise timing (Q4 FY27 to Q2 FY28); manpower cost run-rate ~₹11 crore/quarter and other expenses rising to ~₹47-48 crore in Q4 (outsourcing) need monitoring.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the medium-term order book and export competitiveness, but cautious and sometimes imprecise on near-term margins, commodity pass-through, and utilisation ramp-up. Several answers on tonnage, pricing and capex were non-committal and deferred to later written replies.
